survival.name: survival
survival.seats: Prime + ONE director-kid aimed at a loop brief (two persistent seats, each helping the other to conserve the resource that matters most)
survival.models: Prime claude-opus-5; director claude-sonnet-5 (subscription seat defaults; the owner named both models directly for survival)
survival.source: doc:l4-owner-decisions:265 ('only two persistent seats active each helping the other to conserve the resource that matters most') and :311 ('the Prime + ONE director on a loop brief')

ultimate_survival.name: ultimate survival
ultimate_survival.seats: Prime + single remaining director (the survival pair dropped to the leanest models)
ultimate_survival.models: Prime powered by opus; single remaining director runs off sonnet or even openrouter (owner verbatim)
ultimate_survival.source: doc:l4-owner-decisions:265 ('They can drop down to ultimate survival where Prime is powered by opus and single remaining director runs off sonnet or even openrouter')

enhanced_survival.name: enhanced survival
enhanced_survival.seats: Prime + point director (sanctuary-director) + helper director (sanctuary-helper) — the Texas two-step formation, three seats, helper answers to the point
enhanced_survival.models: Prime claude-opus-5; point director claude-opus-5 max; helper director claude-sonnet-5 max (owner verbatim: 'Helper director kid runs sonnet btw.' 'Sonnet max effort')
enhanced_survival.source: goal:g17.1:26 ('Let's gently dial up the concurrency: spawn a second director kid and let them collab together to split the work... Let the current director take point though and the other one is like a helper') and :28 ('this is just enhanced survival mode')

review.note: defaults for the round-review workflow; resolved by workflow.py run review --harness pi with --args overriding; config-maxxed so it can run on any harness (hypothesis:l3w4-workflows-config-maxxed), 2026-09-07. No 'model' here on purpose: provider is pi, and the pi harness resolves its model from harnesses.pi.models by role, never from this row — a shared model field across disjoint namespaces (Claude Code aliases vs OpenRouter slugs) is what billed Anthropic Sonnet on an OpenRouter key (hypothesis:l3-workflow-model-crosses-harness-namespace, 2026-09-08).

drafting.note: defaults for the brief-drafting workflow; override per run with Workflow args {model, effort}; the drafter seat (hypothesis:l3w4-drafter-seat) reads this row and passes it through — owner quote (6), 2026-09-07. 'sonnet' is correct HERE because provider is claude-code, whose model namespace is subscription aliases, not OpenRouter slugs (hypothesis:l3-workflow-model-crosses-harness-namespace).

deep-search.note: defaults for the deep-search workflow; question, facts, lenses and refute_n arrive via --args, never here or in either workflow file (hypothesis:l3-deep-search-workflow-harness-agnostic), 2026-09-07. No 'model' here on purpose, same reason as workflows.review: provider is pi, model comes from harnesses.pi.models by role (hypothesis:l3-workflow-model-crosses-harness-namespace, 2026-09-08).
